# Ready for Real

> Ready for Real is a launch readiness review for publicly accessible AI-built apps and websites. It scans observable page and technical signals and provides evidence-backed findings and practical remediation guidance.

The free scan does not inspect private source code or backend configuration and is not a security certification or penetration test. A one-time paid upgrade offers a project-specific launch plan and coding-agent brief; see the live site for current pricing and terms.

## Public resources

- [Launch checklist](https://readyforreal.dev/checklists)
